title: Group Fitness Class Passes: purchase price, membership gate, deposit and multi-pack discount rate by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Group Fitness Class Passes product line. For each class-credit pack tier, it states the purchase price, the club-membership gate that must be satisfied to buy the pack, any upfront deposit, and the discount rate applied when a second pack is purchased concurrently.

## Basis by tier
Each tier's purchase price is a fixed dollar amount charged at the time the pack is purchased. Every tier requires the purchasing member to hold a club membership; each tier also sets a minimum membership tier ladder rank the member's own membership must meet or exceed (a rank of 0 means any active membership qualifies). Some tiers require an upfront deposit collected at purchase, refundable rules for which are outside this document's scope. Each tier also fixes a multi-pack discount rate, the percentage by which the tier's price is reduced when the purchasing member already holds another open pack at the time of purchase.

| Tier | Price (USD) | Membership required | Minimum membership tier rank | Deposit (USD) | Multi-pack discount |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5-Class Pack | 75.00 | Yes | 0 (any active) | 0 | 10% |
| 10-Class Pack | 135.00 | Yes | 0 (any active) | 0 | 10% |
| 20-Class Pack | 240.00 | Yes | 0 (any active) | 0 | 10% |
| Unlimited Monthly Classes | 129.00 | Yes | 0 (any active) | 0 | 10% |
| Specialty Studio Pack | 320.00 | Yes | 3 | 50.00 | 10% |
| Founding Class Pass | 99.00 | Yes | 0 (any active) | 0 | 10% |

## Points of judgement
- A member with an active membership at ladder rank 2 may purchase every tier except Specialty Studio Pack, whose minimum required rank is 3.
- The deposit is nonzero only for the Specialty Studio Pack; every other tier carries no upfront deposit.
- The multi-pack discount rate itself is uniform across tiers (10%); which of two possible discounts actually applies when a member also holds a corporate wellness enrollment is governed elsewhere, not by this rate in isolation.
